summary: Lando Norris executed a masterful strategy to win the final Dutch Grand Prix, outmaneuvering Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli through superior pit-stop timing and tire management. Lewis Hamilton criticized Ferrari's delayed team orders, suggesting the slow call to move Charles Leclerc cost him a shot at second place. The victory extends Norris's championship lead as McLaren continues its momentum against Mercedes and Ferrari in the final races of the season.
